runtime_conditions.note: Observer/launcher exit is not a verified task result or a proof of uninterrupted wakefulness.
limitations: Samples do not prove continuous wakefulness between observations.
A gap can reflect sleep, process scheduling, a clock adjustment, or observer delay.
caffeinate -i -s does not guarantee survival of lid close or critical battery sleep.
The wrapper neither reads nor logs authentication material or full system logs.

notes: CLI stdout/model metadata are reported usage and consistency evidence, not independent provider billing attestation.
The frozen index and old reports remain unchanged; separate CLI supplement adds 49 awake baseline02 threads and 49 original-v4 baseline05 threads.
Historical filename-only checks did not detect stdout.jsonl in per-call directories; protocol scanning did. Prior wording claiming no historical nested calls is superseded by this correction.
Token totals include DEV, diagnostics and live calls. Reasoning tokens are included in output; cached tokens are included in input.
The same wall budget and model/effort request were allowed for both arms; total tokens were measured, not matched.
Unknown usage in historical failed calls remains unknown; 34-job total is a known lower bound, not a fabricated bill.

claim_limits: Observed stability is 5/5 registered awake schedules, not a universal guarantee.
All schedules reuse the same 24 live inspection assets; these are timing/order replications, not five independent unseen-image datasets.
Comparison tests the complete workflow: model-generated visual decisions, concurrency, development calibration, guarding and SOOOOL queue. It is not a causal ablation isolating the queue.
Baseline had full shell/background/native nested-model permissions and pair02 autonomously used four concurrent visual CLI processes.
Method had four false accepts of the same asset in pairs02–05 and one normal false rejection in pair04. Passing permits at most one normal rejection and at least11/12 defects.
A signed action receipt authenticates server-side timing/outcome, not the privacy-safe native model transcript or agent-written usage ledger.
No exact model-ready world timestamp is invented from wall-clock subtraction.
All earlier v2/v3/original-v4 failures remain retained; the awake experiment was independently registered before its own runs.
